name: Western & Central (Marmara · Aegean · Mediterranean · Black Sea · Anatolian Plateau)

language.script_notes: Turkish with ı, İ, ş, ğ and ç; the country's most homogeneous Turkish-speaking heartland, with English and German widely used on tourist coast signage.

road_furniture.curb_style: Painted kerbs in towns; wide divided highways and huge urban interchanges in Istanbul and Ankara.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: As national; curved-top street signs are found only in Ankara.

architecture.roof_style: Red-tiled pitched roofs on houses along the western and Mediterranean coasts; flat concrete roofs with water tanks on apartment blocks; wooden gabled houses on the Black Sea.
architecture.roof_material: Red clay tile and flat concrete.
architecture.wall_construction: Whitewashed and pastel houses with tile roofs along the Aegean and Mediterranean; dense concrete apartment blocks in Istanbul, Ankara and Izmir; Ottoman timber houses in historic towns; the fairy-chimney rock dwellings of Cappadocia; timber-and-stone highland houses on the wet Black Sea slopes.
architecture.wall_color_palette: White, cream and pastel on the coast, grey concrete in cities, and warm honey-coloured tuff in Cappadocia.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Istanbul's skyline of domes and pencil minarets; Ottoman timber houses; ancient Greek and Roman ruins on the Aegean and Mediterranean coasts; holiday villas and resort hotels; cone-shaped rock houses in Cappadocia.

nature.vegetation: Olive groves, vineyards and pines on the Aegean and Mediterranean coasts; dry, open steppe across the high central plateau; lush forests, tea plantations and hazelnut groves along the rainy Black Sea coast.
nature.terrain: Coastal plains and hills on the Aegean and Mediterranean, a high plateau of about 900m ringed by mountains in the interior with steppe and volcanic landscapes, and steep, green mountain slopes dropping to the Black Sea.
nature.climate_signature: Mediterranean on the west and south coasts, dry continental steppe on the plateau, and wet, misty and very green along the Black Sea coast.

vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: Yellow taxis in Istanbul, dolmuş minibuses, tractors on farms, and heavy tourist traffic on the coast.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: The densest coverage in the country, across the coasts, the plateau and the cities.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Aegean olive groves, whitewashed houses and red tile roofs
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Turkish letters (ı, ş, ğ), mosques with pencil minarets, white-and-red-reflector bollards and TR plates with a province number distinguish it from Greece's Greek script and churches.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Thrace border region farmland and similar apartment blocks
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Cyrillic versus Latin script with Turkish diacritics, and TR plates, decide it.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same national road furniture and plates
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The west and center are greener, denser and better covered; the east is high, snowy and rugged, and the southeast has flat stone-built plains towns.
